The '''Coop''' is a type of [[Carpenter's Shop#Farm Buildings|farm building]] purchasable and upgradable from [[Robin]] at the [[Carpenter's Shop]]. A coop is present on the farm by default on the Meadowlands [[Farm Maps|Farm Map]]. ==Construction== The Coop takes three days to construct. During this time, [[Robin]] is unreachable for [[Friendship|dialogue or gifting]]. Upgrading the Coop requires two days. During this time, the coop can be used as normal. Robin can be found inside the Coop for purposes such as [[Friendship|dialogue or gifting]]. The total cost of a Deluxe Coop, built from scratch, is {{Price|34000}}, {{Name|Wood|1200|class=inline}} and {{Name|Stone|450|class=inline}} (Or, if all wood and stone are bought from Robin during Year 1, {{Price|55000}}, and {{Price|139000}} if bought in Year 2+.) ==Features== The coop can house [[chicken]]s, [[duck]]s, [[rabbit]]s, and [[dinosaur]]s. Once you have unlocked an animal by building the coop needed to house it, that animal can be placed in any other non-upgraded coops you have built as well. The Deluxe Coop features an Autofeed System; [[hay]] from your [[silo]]s will be automatically distributed. (You can still let the animals feed on [[grass]] outside, and the hay will not be eaten.) Coop Animals may be stuck outside at night if the coop doors are closed. The conditions for this are not clear (see [[Animals#Animals Trapped Outside|Animals trapped outside]]). If an animal is stuck outside the coop at night, the next day their mood will be "grumpy". Animals stuck outside are also subject to [[Animals#Wild Animal Attacks|Wild Animal Attacks]]. The Coop can also be used in a manner similar to the [[Shed]] for storing [[Chest|Chests]], [[Crafting#Artisan Equipment|Artisan Equipment]], [[Furniture]], etc. The animals are undisturbed by the clutter, even if their paths are blocked. However, excessive obstructions may prevent the spawning of [[:Category:Animal Products|coop animal products]].
